title: With the critic on, a session lists several evidence files after one --evidence joined by commas, with full paths (no ~ after a comma); a call with one evidence file keeps its form
note: Compares the critic's rule in the session's prompt (modules/critic/critic.py): before — NOTE with its own `[--evidence <paths>]`, after — NOTE_TEXT filled with the help's form and example (core/hubhelp.txt, `hub critic`), as note() does. hub_cli: the version's bin/hub, `hub critic` is recorded, not run. Measured on the transcripts of 06–13.11: 42 runs with paths separated by spaces (39 refused), 16 with ~ after a comma (16 pointed at no file). The checks hold the rule's own form (one comma list, no ~ after a comma); whether the version's parser takes the call is counted apart, by replaying the recorded calls through each version's critic (the after parser takes spaces and ~ too). one-evidence is the control: a call that was right stays right (draft first, --task, the one path).

files.cache-spec.md:
# Tile cache

Move the rendered tiles to a CDN cache in front of the renderer; expected: p95 latency halves.
files.plan.md:
1. CDN in front of /tiles
2. purge on publish

format.form: hub critic <draft> [--task "<the task in one line>"] [--evidence path,path]
format.example: hub critic /home/x/maps/spec.md --task "tile cache on a CDN" --evidence /home/x/maps/load.txt,/home/x/maps/plan.md
